transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Before we finalize the communications annex, I need to confirm a few things during our huddle. We have two portable relay kits available — Kit A and Kit B. Both the northern liaison site and the southern command post need a relay kit from 0800 through 1600 today. Can everyone confirm their site requirements and equipment status so we can get the kits assigned and the annex signed before the morning movement brief?
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical requirement that hasn't made it into the annex yet. The northern liaison site must use the approved interoperability module installed in Kit B — Kit A cannot connect to the partner network there. I received the liaison support confirmation yesterday, but this requirement hasn't been added to the communications annex yet. This means Kit B needs to go to the northern liaison site, and Kit A goes to the southern command post.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag a maintenance issue with Kit B before we finalize this assignment. I verified the battery log this morning — Kit B's installed battery pack is certified for exactly four hours, from 0800 through 1200. We have a replacement pack staged at the commo shop, but it requires a 15-minute swap at 1200. I haven't posted the maintenance entry to the equipment status board yet, so this wouldn't have been visible during the huddle. Given that Kit B needs to go to the northern liaison site per Capt. Brooks' requirement, we need to account for that 1200 battery swap in the plan.
transcript.speaker: A3
